ree.resolution: PRB-OEE Resolution 40 s.2024 applies from next scheduled exam and subsequent, superseding Res23 s.2011
ree.current_order_advisory: 28 August 2026 adjusts order only, not weights

current_scope_revalidation.other_boards: Previously verified repository scope records remain consistent; no scope-changing evidence found in this targeted audit.

cpa_post_batch636.saturation_assessment: INTENTIONAL_DEFICIENCY_CLOSURE — 698 additions were needed to raise all 113 baseline leaves to at least10; Batch636 added700 and final distribution is 111 at10, two at11. This shape alone is not evidence of padding; artifact reports 209 scenario and 209 misconception families after, calculation families 9→40, max family13, 320 reviewed, and all traceability/dedup gates passing.

cpa_defect_forensics.classification_basis: The B636 code increments content_repairs for every generated non-calculation item and reruns those records through b636_semantic_content; this is deterministic first-pass content replacement, not 603 independently logged answer/source defects.
cpa_defect_forensics.followup: No immediate expansion; bounded sample/standard-currentness QA only if new evidence identifies concrete faults.

ce_flashcard_exception.root_cause: Batch634 CE questions use unsupported content_blocks type study_focus; StructuredContentService accepts text/equation/table/chart/figure, so all 259 fail question validation and are excluded from flashcard derivation as invalid questions. The exclusions are not benign: these active canonical items were intended to be usable, so this is a real learner-facing integrity defect, not a taxonomy or flashcard-tool false positive.
ce_flashcard_exception.repair_priority: HIGH — learner-facing integrity defect; replace/normalize only the malformed blocks in a separate bounded CE integrity repair, preserving stems, keys and IDs.
